original_target.title: Bressan's logarithmic lower bound on the cost of mixing

scope_comparison: Brue–Colombo–Johansson Theorems1.4/1.5 yield asymptotic mixing-rate bounds for time-periodic fields; §1.5 retains the one-time endpoint problem. Their large-time Lyapunov average cannot supply a uniform one-time strain lower bound for arbitrary smooth time dependence. Ergodic weak mixing, quantum mixing curvature and graph Bressan results in provider listings are unrelated.
